gloss: starting station; first station on a line

definitions.gloss: starting station; terminal station where a train line originates
definitions.explanation: The first station on a train line or the station where a particular train service begins its run. Passengers boarding here are guaranteed a seat.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{始発駅|しはつえき}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{座|すわ}れる→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: Since this is the starting station, we can get seats.

examples.japanese: {始発駅|しはつえき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{乗|の}れば→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ→通勤ラッシュ：08486_tsuukinrasshu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: If you board from the starting station, you can secure a seat even during rush hour.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{始発駅|しはつえき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{東京駅|とうきょうえき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{終点|しゅうてん}→終点：05457_shuuten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{熱海駅|あたみえき}です。
examples.english: The starting station of this line is Tokyo Station, and the last stop is Atami Station.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{始発|しはつ}→始発：03063_shihatsu⟧ (first departure; originating) and ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧ (station). The term refers specifically to the station where a train begins its run, not to a random stop along the way.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {始発駅|しはつえき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ — to board from the starting station
- {始発駅|しはつえき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ — to line up at the starting station
- ⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{始発駅|しはつえき} — the starting station of a line

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{始発|しはつ}→始発：03063_shihatsu⟧ — first train/bus of the day (also used as a modifier meaning "originating")
- ⟦{終着駅|しゅうちゃくえき}→終着駅：23879_shuuchakueki⟧ / ⟦{終点|しゅうてん}→終点：05457_shuuten⟧ — terminal station; last stop
- ⟦{起点|きてん}→起点：16254_kiten⟧ — starting point (more abstract; not limited to trains)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Tokyo and other major cities, living near a {始発駅|しはつえき} is valued by commuters because it guarantees a seat on the train. Some people choose apartments near starting stations specifically for this advantage.
